name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
beneficiary_desc: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land.
benefits_summary: Direct income support of 6,000 rupees per year paid in three equal installments of 2,000 rupees.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
beneficiary_desc: Low-income and vulnerable families identified by socio-economic criteria.
benefits_summary: Cashless health insurance coverage up to 5 lakh rupees per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.

name: PM SVANidhi
beneficiary_desc: Urban and peri-urban street vendors and hawkers.
benefits_summary: Collateral-free working capital micro-loans of 10,000 to 50,000 rupees with interest subsidy on regular repayment.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
beneficiary_desc: Traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 family-based trades.
benefits_summary: Recognition certificate, skill training with daily stipend, 15,000 rupees toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to 3 lakh rupees at 5 percent interest.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Gramin
beneficiary_desc: Houseless and rural families living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
benefits_summary: Financial grant of 1.20 lakh rupees in plains and 1.30 lakh in hilly areas, plus 90 days of MGNREGA wages to construct a pucca house.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
beneficiary_desc: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises seeking business loans.
benefits_summary: Collateral-free micro enterprise loans up to 10 lakh rupees under Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun categories.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
beneficiary_desc: Girl children up to age 10 opened by natural or legal guardians.
benefits_summary: High-interest sovereign savings account with triple tax exemption (EEE) under Section 80C for girl child higher education and marriage.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
beneficiary_desc: Citizens in the unorganized sector without statutory social security.
benefits_summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of 1,000 to 5,000 rupees after age 60 depending on monthly contribution.

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA
beneficiary_desc: Rural adult citizens willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits_summary: Statutory guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year per rural household.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
beneficiary_desc: Bank account holders between ages 18 and 70.
benefits_summary: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of 2 lakh rupees for an annual premium of only 20 rupees.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
beneficiary_desc: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or female entrepreneurs setting up greenfield ventures.
benefits_summary: Composite bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 crore rupees for manufacturing, services, or trading enterprises.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
beneficiary_desc: Farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and animal husbandry practitioners.
benefits_summary: Short-term production credit up to 3 lakh rupees at subsidized 4 percent effective interest rate upon prompt repayment.
